text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">完成区域业务要求</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">合理利用业务资源</span><span lang="EN-US">, </span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">制定区域工作计划和工作目标</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">通过协访，基于行为给予医药代表辅导反馈</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">甄选、开发和维护区域内目标医院</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">组织安排区域市场推广和业务活动</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">管理区域行政事务，建立有效的跨部门沟通与合作参与区域人员甄选、招聘和培训</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">考核医药代表绩效，并帮助代表制定员工发展计划</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">严格遵守国家法律法规、《医药代表管理办法》及公司各项合规制度，确保所有学术推广活动合法合规，不存在法律法规及公司各项合规制度中禁止医药代表从事的行为。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal"><strong><span lang="EN-US">REQUIREMENTS/</span></strong><strong><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">任职资格：</span></strong></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">医学或药学专业本科或以上学历</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">五年以上中型外企住院处方药医学推广经验，至少两年以上团队管理经验，有较好的与医院客户医学推广互动经验，有一定的开发和产品医学推广经验，有肠内外营养产品医学推广经验者优先考虑。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">具备管理团队的良好领导力</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">具备良好的沟通、计划及资源分配能力</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">具备良好的人际沟通和谈判技巧</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">具备医药行业的敏锐的市场直觉</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">愿意接受挑战和承受工作压力</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">经公司培训并考核合格</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span><span style="font-family: 等线; mso-ascii-font-family: Calibri; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-font-family: Calibri; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin;">确保在医药代表平台能完成您的医药代表信息备案</span></p> </div></div>
